name: XFlight: FPV Drone Simulator
detailed_description:
Note: If you encounter issues with a game not running, please first visit the Microsoft official website to download the necessary game runtime libraries.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

XFlight is the next-generation FPV simulator, crafted by an ambitious team with a promising future.

XFlight has the following features:

- Excellent flight handling feel

- Friendly to beginners

- Tons of user-generated contents to explore

You can gradually master FPV flying skills in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere. This simulator is the best choice to let you embark on your FPV journey.

UE5 Engine

The simulator is developed based on UE5 Engine, ensuring graphics quality. Its physics engine delivers excellent performance - simply tuning parameters allows you to experience smooth flight.

Beginner-Friendly Tutorial

XFlight is currently the most beginner-friendly FPV simulator. Its built-in tutorial system offers clear guidance, simple operation, and easy-start, with future plans to provide more advanced tutorials.

Take off Instantly

No complex tuning needed, select preset models and take off instantly.

Advanced Tuning

The quad's parameter page is clear and concise, allowing precise customization based on your needs. You can quickly tune parameters in the simulator to match real-world flight feel, then share these parameters with other players via one-click sharing.

X Lab

Minecraft-like creative joy. Built-in creation tools based on a component system, simple yet powerful. It's not just a track editor but also a mini-game maker.

Community Challenge

Mario-Maker-like novel experience. In community challenge, tracks crafted by warmhearted players await your challenge—or create your own for others.

Community-driven

We are committed to building a community-driven FPV simulator. We carefully listen to your voices, your suggestions have a high chance of appearing in the next update list.

XFlight is currently in the EA phase, it is in high-speed update, every 1-2 weeks there will be new version releases. The development team looks forward to hearing your voices, hoping to progress together with you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 8th gen / AMD Ryzen 1st gen - 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 - 2GB VRAM or more.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 需要使用无人机遥控器或游戏手柄游玩
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 & Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel 10th gen / AMD Ryzen 3rd gen - 3.0GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX 2060 / AMD RX Vega 56 - 4GB VRAM or more.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 需要使用无人机遥控器或游戏手柄游玩
